title: Notifications of one chat
summary: Per chat choice of what notifies, from the chat info or a long press in the chat list. A DM offers all messages or mute; a group also offers mentions only (ADR 0141).

mode.description: default: follows notification-settings. Else the user-defined mode of this room.

legacyMentionsInDm.description: A DM that already has a mentions-only rule from before. Shows bipe_dm_notifications_mentions_disclaimer and keeps the rule until the person picks another mode.

setMode.effect: NotificationSettings.setRoomNotificationMode. mute shows a muted icon on the chat-list row.

notes: The one DM test is Room.isDirect (ADR 0141).
No mute-for-a-time (8 hours, a week) in phase 1.
